errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled with the symbol '%' not the word 'Prozent'.
The description states the bars are bluish, but fails to mention that the bars for OECD and EU27 are a different color (purple/mauve).

errors.text_span: Japan weist den höchsten Balken auf und erreicht ungefähr 90 %
errors.evidence: The description states the value for Japan is approximately 90%, but the bar is clearly lower, at around 88%.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für Südkorea liegt bei ungefähr 85 %
errors.evidence: The description states the value for Südkorea is approximately 85%, but the bar clearly aligns with the 80% mark on the y-axis.
The description states the value for Denmark is approximately 82%, but the bar is clearly below the 80% line, at approximately 79%.
The description states the value for OECD is approximately 75%, but the bar is visibly lower, at approximately 72%.
The description states the value for Poland is approximately 73%, but the bar aligns with the 70% mark.

errors.text_span: markiert den Wert für die USA
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the blue dot marks the value for the USA. The dot is located next to the bar for 'Vereinigtes Königreich' (United Kingdom).
The description claims the value marked by the dot is approximately 72%. The dot is visually located far below this, at approximately 61-62%.
